dispute_ticket.description: I pressed I'm Here at 11:02 and waited 9 minutes at the lobby but the passenger never came, so I cancelled. The no-show fee was not paid out to me. Please apply it.

chat_logs.content: Where are you? I'm at Tower 3 lobby.
Still waiting at the lobby, I see no white Harrier.

app_events.details: Driver tapped 'I'm Here' (no GPS position check recorded).
Driver cancelled; reason: rider did not board. Wait counted from driver_arrived: 9 min 00 s.
Rider app location within 30 m of pickup point.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from the driver_arrived event, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit counts: exactly 8 min 00 s meets it.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It covers rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: The decisive fact is whether the driver was at the pickup point. The driver_arrived event at 11:02:00 and the 9 min 00 s wait (11:02:00 to 11:11:00) would exceed the 8-min threshold, but the driver GPS places the vehicle moving en_route at 11:02:00, 11:06:00 and 11:09:30 and about 3 km from Suntec City at 11:02:00 and still about 0.9 km away at 11:09:30 (it only stops at 11:11:00, about 0.6 km from the lobby), and the rider's messages at 11:05:00 and 11:08:00 say she was in the lobby and saw no car, while her app ping at 11:11:30 is within 30 m of pickup. The arrival event (no GPS check recorded) and the GPS contradict each other, so neither a no-show nor a driver failure can be ruled on from these records. A person must decide.
